title: Gap5 staging 集群复测（kind 实测）

environment.cluster: kind travel-staging (kind v0.29.0, GitHub Actions ubuntu runner)
adaptations: single-node kind: HPAs deleted, 1 replica per service, api request 200m/384Mi (production overlay unchanged)
no pulsar/redis/nacos in kind: api env TRAVEL_EVENT_BUS=local, TRAVEL_A2A_TRANSPORT=mock, TRAVEL_A2A_AUDIT_MIRROR_PULSAR=false (same as CI test suite)
TLS secret placeholders replaced with self-signed cert (certs not committed)
a2a-metrics cronjob suspended during smoke window

canary.method: sequential HTTP load via kubectl port-forward; success = HTTP 200; percentiles nearest-rank; legacy = POST /recommend (api, python legacy ranker + go-ranker shadow), new = POST /v1/score/hotel (go-ranker)

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.defect: go-policy image lacked policy.rego — rego.Load panicked at startup, CrashLoopBackOff
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.fix: Dockerfile COPY policy.rego into runtime image

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.defect: go-registry-cache StatefulSet referenced undefined ServiceAccount go-registry-cache-sa — FailedCreate
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.fix: define SA + endpoints-reader Role/RoleBinding in serviceaccount.yaml

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.defect: runtime go_ranker_client metrics flush raised OSError (read-only rootfs) and turned user requests into 500
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.fix: telemetry write failure now logs and continues; python regression green

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.defect: pulsar client publish() blocks 30s per call without broker (fallback-to-local never triggered: constructor does not raise)
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_retest.fix: staging harness injects TRAVEL_EVENT_BUS=local for smoke; local repro stress/repro_recommend_hang.py (200/4.1s after fix)
